note: One Free F0 Language resource per subscription; if refused redeploy with skuName=S and say so. A leaked string or a failed gate is the episode: do not edit the cases.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-12 -l westeurope -o none
$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-12 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
python -m ticketnlp show --id en-neg-vpn | Out-Null   # dry run

screens.name: resource
steps: Open the Language resource in rg-mglab-ai-12 > Overview (pricing tier Free F0, region West Europe, endpoint masked)
Open Keys and Endpoint / Identity and show local authentication disabled
Open Access control (IAM) > Role assignments and show Cognitive Services Language Reader for the lab account
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-12 -n $env:LANG_NAME -l westeurope
